$description: Closed set of motion patterns observed in the clone (values measured on the source during the clone build; see CLONE_SPEC motion M1-M17 and the pages spec P1-P24, superseded where the code documents a measured correction). Every pattern carries its fixed reduced-motion fallback.

patterns.description: No motion; content renders in its final state.

M1 page-load intro: badge/H1/subhead/CTAs opacity 0 + blur 1.5px to rest, 600ms ease-reveal, 100ms stagger; main window opacity + scale .98 to 1, 900ms from 450ms; side windows fade 900ms at 1200/1350/1500ms.
M3 threshold scroll state (>= md): text fades and blurs 500ms out-cubic; windows scale to .95 with the hero spring (720ms).
M2 conic-gradient origin travels 150px/s along the badge, 320ms turns at each end, ~4.0s loop at a 283px badge.
P1/P2 marketing hero entrance: badge/title/lead opacity 0 + y 4px to rest, 1s ease-in-out at 100/200/300ms; dot pattern 1s ease-out at 900ms.
Scroll-spy: the active item follows the article/category whose top crossed 45% (showcase) or 30% (app directory) of the viewport; label colour 320ms out-cubic.
Timed tab cycling with a linear progress fill: stories 6000ms (M7), context accordion 5000ms (M10); text/image cross-fade with blur ~500ms.
Continuous linear loops: integration marquee 30px/s (51.2s per set), signal roller 24s, creator carousel duration set inline.
M12 scroll-linked quote: words recolour from caption grey to ink as the sticky panel scrolls (~1 word per 70px), each 500ms ease-out.
C5 in-view quote: each word rises from 36px with opacity, 500ms ease-reveal, ~10ms stagger, once.
M13 layout-only curtain: the light quote section is pulled under the dark stack (negative top margin of one viewport) with a sticky inner panel. No animation code.
M9 eyebrow + mega title reveal (opacity, blur, y 4px) and horizon glow scale .84 to 1 as the section reaches the viewport top.
M14 chart: curve clip-path reveal 1.2s ease-reveal, grid fade 1.1s, wash fade .6s at 1.3s; stat blocks 600ms at 150/250/350/450ms.
M16 falling streaks: thin gradient lines on the stripe columns, random timing (approx. 2-4s each).
M15 decorative loops inside product artwork: radar ring opacity pulses 3600ms, node bob 3800ms+, caret blink 550ms.
P11-P13 avatar wall: tiles fade 300ms with pseudo-random delays .23-.83s; heading lines rise 600ms at 600/750ms; buttons 700ms at 1s.
P3/P4 pricing frame lines sweep in 1.5s ease-out with staggered delays; corner marks fade 1s at 1s.
Pricing digits roll between monthly and annual values when the billing toggle changes.
Accordion panel height 0 <-> auto, 300ms in-out-cubic; plus/minus icon 400ms.
M17 micro-interactions: button colours 300ms, hover wash .8 in 50ms / out 300ms, trailing arrow x+2px, story image saturate .55 to 1.
T4.2 featured tab content: blur and opacity to rest, 300ms ease-in-out.
M4 header colours/background/border transition 250ms when it crosses dark sections.
M5 navigation dropdown: 150ms in-out-cubic open/close; panel content slides with blur 8px over 200ms.
Mobile navigation drawer: slide from top + overlay fade, 500ms drawer ease.
P18 search dialog: overlay fade + content scale .96 to 1, 200ms in-out-quad (exit reverses).
P24 gallery lightbox overlay + prev/next fade, 200ms in-out-quad.
Heatmap squares fade in when the grid enters the viewport (random 0-600ms stagger, 300ms).
Scroll-driven typewriter: phrases type out across a 300svh scroll runway under a pinned 100svh stage; caret blink and scroll cue loop (P26/P27).
P29 scroll-lit words: each word brightens (colour 500ms ease-out, pillars 300ms) as it passes the viewport line.
Animated canvas fields (dots/network/rings) drawn at 30fps while in view; drifting chapter blobs (P28).
Form feedback: select popup fade + 4px slide 150ms (P16); error message fade 300ms ease-out (P19); submit spinner.

Two rows of cards translate in opposite directions in proportion to scroll (about 0.0985px per px scrolled once the band is 870px below the viewport top), smoothed by a spring; no time-based loop (CLONE_SPEC_PLATFORM M-S3).
